say:1:1623363001:2.text: The student in front of you lets out a long yawn and looks at you with half-awake eyes.
say:1:1623363001:2.source_cn: 眼前的学生打了个长长的哈欠，睡眼惺忪地望向你。
say:1:1623363001:2.male: The student in front of you lets out a long yawn and looks at you with half-awake eyes.
say:1:1623363001:2.female: The student in front of you lets out a long yawn and looks at you with half-awake eyes.

say:4:1623363004:3.text: The court mage selection was coming up, so everyone went nuts. Stayed up late every night, crammed books, practiced spells till our hands hurt! 'Cause if you get in, you're basically set. Good pay, good name. Who wouldn't want that?!
say:4:1623363004:3.source_cn: 宫廷魔法师选拔开始前，大家熬夜背书、练习咒语，头发都快...
say:4:1623363004:3.male: The court mage selection was coming up, so everyone went nuts. Stayed up late every night, crammed books, practiced spells till our hands hurt! 'Cause if you get in, you're basically set. Good pay, good name. Who wouldn't want that?!
say:4:1623363004:3.female: The court mage selection was coming up, so everyone went nuts. Stayed up late every night, crammed books, practiced spells till our hands hurt! 'Cause if you get in, you're basically set. Good pay, good name. Who wouldn't want that?!

say:5:1623363005:1.text: But we didn't make it. So now it all feels like a bad joke. Honestly, I hear "magic" and my heart starts pounding like I'm about to die!
say:5:1623363005:1.source_cn: 现在好了，全泡汤了！我现在听到魔法两个字，心都突突跳！
say:5:1623363005:1.male: But we didn't make it. So now it all feels like a bad joke. Honestly, I hear "magic" and my heart starts pounding like I'm about to die!
say:5:1623363005:1.female: But we didn't make it. So now it all feels like a bad joke. Honestly, I hear "magic" and my heart starts pounding like I'm about to die!

say:6:1623363006:1.text: And I can't sleep anymore. I just lie there thinking... "Guess I'm gonna fail again next time too."
say:6:1623363006:1.source_cn: 哈啊……落选之后，晚上更是睡不着，满脑子都是未来的一次...
say:6:1623363006:1.male: And I can't sleep anymore. I just lie there thinking... "Guess I'm gonna fail again next time too."
say:6:1623363006:1.female: And I can't sleep anymore. I just lie there thinking... "Guess I'm gonna fail again next time too."

say:8:1623363008:1.text: He rubs his eyes hard, then stares at you like he's finally seeing you clearly. The drowsiness is gone.
say:8:1623363008:1.source_cn: 他忽然使劲揉了揉眼睛，死死盯着你，睡意全无。
say:8:1623363008:1.male: He rubs his eyes hard, then stares at you like he's finally seeing you clearly. The drowsiness is gone.
say:8:1623363008:1.female: He rubs his eyes hard, then stares at you like he's finally seeing you clearly. The drowsiness is gone.

say:9:1623363009:2.text: N-no way... you're Merlin. Professor Merlin?!
say:9:1623363009:2.source_cn: 你、你、你……你是梅林！梅林老师？！
say:9:1623363009:2.male: N-no way... you're Merlin. Professor Merlin?!
say:9:1623363009:2.female: N-no way... you're Merlin. Professor Merlin?!

say:10:1623363010:1.text: The name "Merlin" hits like an awakening spell, and everyone perks up as if someone lit a fire under them.
say:10:1623363010:1.source_cn: “梅林”这个名字像一道清醒咒，瞬间驱散了周围的消极氛围。
say:10:1623363010:1.male: The name "Merlin" hits like an awakening spell, and everyone perks up as if someone lit a fire under them.
say:10:1623363010:1.female: The name "Merlin" hits like an awakening spell, and everyone perks up as if someone lit a fire under them.

say:11:1623363011:1.text: The students who were slouching a second ago rush over, eyes bright.
say:11:1623363011:1.source_cn: 原本东倒西歪的学生们一下全围了过来，眼睛闪闪发光。

say:13:1623363012:1.text: Merlin?! THE Merlin?! Am I dreaming?!
say:13:1623363012:1.source_cn: 梅林！是梅林老师本人！我是不是还在做梦？！
say:13:1623363012:1.male: Merlin?! THE Merlin?! Am I dreaming?!
say:13:1623363012:1.female: Merlin?! THE Merlin?! Am I dreaming?!

say:14:1623363013:1.text: Professor Merlin, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for us, so we were thinking... uh, could you maybe run a quick practice round with us? Nothing serious. Just a few tips while we try out some spells.
say:14:1623363013:1.source_cn: 梅林老师，机会难得，我们能不能……跟您切磋一下？！就当...
say:14:1623363013:1.male: Professor Merlin, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for us, so we were thinking... uh, could you maybe run a quick practice round with us? Nothing serious. Just a few tips while we try out some spells.
say:14:1623363013:1.female: Professor Merlin, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for us, so we were thinking... uh, could you maybe run a quick practice round with us? Nothing serious. Just a few tips while we try out some spells.

say:15:1623363014:1.text: Getting to trade spells with a legend... oh Dura above, I'm going to learn so much from this!
say:15:1623363014:1.source_cn: 和传奇大魔法师切磋魔法技巧……女神啊，我一定能学到超多...
say:15:1623363014:1.male: Getting to trade spells with a legend... oh Dura above, I'm going to learn so much from this!
say:15:1623363014:1.female: Getting to trade spells with a legend... oh Dura above, I'm going to learn so much from this!

choice_prompt:16:1623363014.text: Getting to trade spells with a legend... oh Dura above, I'm going to learn so much from this!
choice_prompt:16:1623363014.source_cn: 和传奇大魔法师切磋魔法技巧……女神啊，我一定能学到超多的知识！
choice_prompt:16:1623363014.male: Getting to trade spells with a legend... oh Dura above, I'm going to learn so much from this!
choice_prompt:16:1623363014.female: Getting to trade spells with a legend... oh Dura above, I'm going to learn so much from this!

say:17:1623363015:4.text: The students explode with excitement. They all but trip over each other as they rush over, their eyes bright again with that eager look.
say:17:1623363015:4.source_cn: 学生们瞬间沸腾，争先恐后地围拢上来，眼中重燃热切的光彩。

say:18:1623363016:1.text: Cheers burst out right away. The young mages crack their knuckles, shake out their hands, and start lining up like they can't wait another second.
say:18:1623363016:1.source_cn: 现场立刻爆发出欢呼，年轻人们摩拳擦掌，迫不及待地准备迎...

choice:3:0:1.text: Why are you all looking so dead on your feet?
choice:3:0:1.male: Why are you all looking so dead on your feet?
choice:3:0:1.female: Why are you all looking so dead on your feet?

say:20:1623363003:2.text: Wow. And here I thought I was the brutally honest one!
say:20:1623363003:2.source_cn: 呃……你倒是比我还心直口快！
say:20:1623363003:2.male: Wow. And here I thought I was the brutally honest one!
say:20:1623363003:2.female: Wow. And here I thought I was the brutally honest one!

choice:3:1:2.text: You all look like you haven't slept for days.
choice:3:1:2.male: You all look like you haven't slept for days.
choice:3:1:2.female: You all look like you haven't slept for days.
